episodes.synopsis: Gymnast Jotaro Aragaki is told by his coach to retire, but he can't bring himself to tell his family.
episodes.title: Retiring Samurai

episodes.synopsis: After the press conference where he failed to announce his retirement, Jotaro has to figure out his next steps.
episodes.title: Rock-Bottom Samurai

episodes.synopsis: Young up-and-coming gymnast, Tetsuo Minamino, challenges Jotaro to a gymnastics duel with Jōtarō's career on the line.
episodes.title: Dueling Samurai

episodes.synopsis: As Jotaro works hard to prepare for the NHK Cup, Leo notices that Rei has been acting strange, so he tries to find out what's wrong.
episodes.title: Samurai Daughter.

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the NHK Cup, Jotaro's first official competition after his press conference, but all eyes are on the young gymnasts he's competing against.
episodes.title: Battling Samurai

episodes.synopsis: Rei's birthday is coming up, but with Jotaro busy preparing for the joint training camp with China, she is left alone to face her feelings.
episodes.title: Samurai Father and Daughter

episodes.synopsis: At the joint training camp with China, Jotaro and the other Japanese gymnasts see the powerful gymnastics of the Chinese team firsthand.
episodes.title: Training Camp Samurai

episodes.synopsis: Kitty comes to visit Rei in Japan and takes her on a shopping spree. Meanwhile, Jotaro works on his quadruple with the help of Leo.
episodes.title: Intensive Training Samurai

episodes.synopsis: As All-Japan draws near, Jotaro practices hard to perfect his new move in time for the competition, but he has an unexpected setback.
episodes.title: Ninja & Samurai

episodes.synopsis: Jotaro is determined to show Leo the new move that Leo helped him complete, but as the competition starts, Leo is nowhere to be found.
episodes.title: Samurai's Decisive Battle

episodes.synopsis: All eyes are on Jotaro on the day of the All-Japan finals, but Leo is already on his way to the airport to go back to London.
episodes.title: Gymnastics Samurai
